subject: Horizon Health DPA - subprocessor & data-use signoff needed
messages:
From: Natalie Gomez <natalie.gomez@horizonhealth.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.inference>; Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference>
Cc: Horizon Health Legal <contracts@horizonhealth.com>
Date: Fri, 7 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Horizon DPA redline + subprocessors for analytics pilot

Hi Karthik / Marissa,

Thanks for the demo last week — Horizon is excited to pilot the inference routing for our clinician summarization flow. Attached is our redlined DPA (v3) and a short SOW. Two asks flagged in the redline: one to allow an analytics subprocessor (InsightMetrics) for usage-based dashboards, and a second to permit limited telemetry export for model-quality signals (no PHI; hashed IDs). We tried to capture retention at 90 days but left the exact telemetry fields open.

Can you confirm Redwood's ability to: 1) list InsightMetrics as a subprocessor (they will only receive aggregated metrics), 2) scope telemetry fields and retention, and 3) confirm there will be no model training on Horizon data?

Attachments: Horizon_DPA_Redline_v3.docx, Horizon_SOW_Draft.pdf

Best,
Natalie Gomez
Senior Contract Manager, Horizon Health

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.inference>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.inference>; Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.inference>; Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference>; Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.inference>
Cc: Natalie Gomez <natalie.gomez@horizonhealth.com>
Date: Fri, 7 Aug 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Horizon DPA redline + subprocessors for analytics pilot

Folks — looping you in. Horizon sent their redline and are explicitly asking for: 1) acceptance of a third-party analytics subprocessor (InsightMetrics) limited to aggregated metrics; 2) a telemetry export carveout with ~90d retention; 3) explicit confirmation there will be no training on Horizon data.

Quick asks from Product/security perspective:
- Product: will the telemetry Horizon requests include any model inputs or just aggregated inference-level metrics? Also, can we enforce a 90d TTL on any export buckets?
- Security/Privacy: Any concerns listing InsightMetrics as a subprocessor (vendor risk, encryption-at-rest, SOC evidence)?

Olga — can Legal propose language we can live with that limits InsightMetrics to aggregated metrics and forbids model training? Soojin/Marissa/Evelyn — please flag blockers or quick mitigations. I'll keep Horizon on the thread for transparency but please reply-all with concrete suggested edits.

Thanks,
Karthik
Product Lead, Inference Platform

From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.inference>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.inference>; Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference>; Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.inference>; Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.inference>
Cc: Natalie Gomez <natalie.gomez@horizonhealth.com>
Date: Sat, 8 Aug 2026 08:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Horizon DPA redline + subprocessors for analytics pilot

Karthik — reviewed the redline. I can propose narrow language to accept InsightMetrics as a named subprocessor subject to: (a) contract flowdown requiring SOC2 Type II or equivalent, (b) encryption-at-rest and in transit, (c) prohibition on any access to raw input text or model outputs that could contain PHI, and (d) explicit prohibition on using Horizon data for any model training or improvement.

Suggested clause (draft): "Customer permits Redwood to engage InsightMetrics as a subprocessor solely for the purpose of generating aggregated usage metrics. InsightMetrics shall not receive raw inference inputs, raw model outputs, or any data elements that could reasonably identify individuals; InsightMetrics shall not use, access, or train models using Customer Data; Redwood shall require and maintain contractual flowdown obligations (including SOC2 Type II evidence) from InsightMetrics."

Also, on retention: 90 days is acceptable on exported telemetry as long as we can enforce TTL on the export bucket and log deletion events for audit. Need product to confirm feasibility and operations to confirm deletions are automated and auditable.

I'll prepare a redline back to Horizon with the proposed clause and a short appendix listing required vendor evidence.

Regards,
Olga
Senior Counsel, Contracts

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.inference>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.inference>; Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.inference>; Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference>; Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.inference>
Cc: Natalie Gomez <natalie.gomez@horizonhealth.com>
Date: Sun, 8 Aug 2026 13:16:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Horizon DPA redline + subprocessors for analytics pilot

Thanks, Olga. Security notes: we can support listing InsightMetrics provided we validate: 1) they have SOC2 Type II with a recent report (within 12 months), 2) they support customer-managed keys or at minimum AES-256 at rest and TLS1.2+ in transit, 3) we add a scoped attestation that they will not process PHI. Operationally: TTL enforcement for exported telemetry is doable if we push to a retention-enabled bucket in our cloud account tied to Horizon's project/namespace. We will need a runbook for deletion verification and a logged deletion event that can be surfaced in the Console audit trail.

One product caveat: if Horizon wants per-query signal (e.g., per-inference confidence + prompt metadata) we must be explicit that even hashed IDs can carry re-identification risk; aggregated dashboards are okay but per-query export will require a higher control bar and may need a narrow field allowlist.

Action items for Product/security:
- Product: confirm exact telemetry fields Horizon expects.
- Infra/SRE (ops): confirm TTL enforcement and deletion logs can be produced to meet audit.

Soojin
Head of Security Engineering

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.inference>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.inference>; Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.inference>; Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference>; Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.inference>; Natalie Gomez <natalie.gomez@horizonhealth.com>
Date: Mon, 9 Aug 2026 17:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Horizon DPA redline + subprocessors for analytics pilot — proposed path

Team and Natalie — thanks for the quick reviews. Summary / proposed path forward:

1) Legal (Olga) will send a redline accepting InsightMetrics with the clause she drafted and a short vendor evidence appendix.
2) Security (Soojin) will require SOC2 Type II + encryption and an attestation w/operational runbook.
3) Product (me) will ask Horizon to provide a telemetry field allowlist (we will not export raw inputs or outputs). For Horizon: please confirm which metrics you need (suggested minimum: per-day request counts, latency percentiles, aggregated confidence buckets). If you require per-query signals, note we will need to scope that tightly and add extra controls.
3a) We (Product + Ops) will confirm TTL enforcement and audit deletion events; target: automated TTL in 90 days and deletion log surfaced in Console.
4) Once Legal has the redline, I will send to Horizon with the proposed operational appendix and a target to close DPA by EOD Wed (2026-08-11).

Natalie — please confirm the telemetry allowlist by EOD Tue so Product can validate.

Action items assigned: Olga (redline + appendix), Soojin (SOC2 check + attestation text), Marissa/Evelyn (privacy questions — retention and scope), Karthik (coordinate final send).

Thanks all — cc'ing Horizon for visibility.
Karthik
Product Lead, Inference Platform
